verdict.rationale: Buzz documents built-in workflow automation inside the chat tool: YAML-as-code automation with traces, CLI commands to trigger and approve workflows, and workflow runs searchable next to conversations. The automation is code-defined (YAML) rather than no-code, and nothing shows event, schedule, or form-submission triggers. Missing for 10: no-code visual builder, event-based triggers, scheduled/recurring triggers, form-submission triggers, admin-facing builder docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can build no-code workflows triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions inside the chat tool

citations.quote: buzz workflows trigger --workflow buzz workflows approve --token
Search the conversation, the patch, the workflow run, and the approval in one place
